entrance.title: How do you use Nexus?
entrance.description: This chooses your workspace layout. It is not your writing identity — Creator profiles stay as they are.

contentCreator.title: Content creator
contentCreator.description: Write and worldbuild. Agents help you. You do not install modules or edit presets.

developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Build on Nexus. Modules, presets, capabilities, Connect, and the full Control Room.

agent.title: Choose an agent
agent.description: Nexus uses an agent to run strategies. Select a discovered agent to continue.

workspace.title: Name your Profile
workspace.description: Nexus creates your first Profile. Choose a display name and a workspace folder for your creative projects. We will create the folder if it does not exist.

done.title: You're ready 🎉
done.description: Open Nexus to start writing. You can change settings anytime.

error.title: Could not scan for agents
error.fallbackDescription: The daemon did not respond to the agent scan request.

empty.title: No agents found on PATH
empty.description: Install an agent, or continue with a custom launch command.

agentPicker.verifyNoMatch: No matching agent for this command. Check the command and try again.
agentPicker.verifyError: Could not reach this agent. Check the command and try again.

workspace.label: Workspace folder
workspace.browserOnly: Workspace path changes are available on the desktop app only.

starting.title: Starting daemon…
starting.description: This takes a few seconds on first launch.

daemon.resetDatabaseDescription: This will clear the daemon's local state database (config, registry cache). Your creative files in the workspace are not affected.

error.daemonSlowStart: Daemon is taking longer than expected to start. You can retry or reset the local database.
error.daemonStatusUnknown: Could not determine daemon status. Try retrying.
error.folderPickerFailed: Could not open the folder picker.
error.workspacePathFailed: Could not save the workspace path.
error.workspaceBootstrapFailed: Could not prepare your local workspace.
error.profileDisplayNameFailed: Could not save the Profile name.

degraded.body: Nexus service unavailable: {{reason}}. Make sure the local service is running, then retry.

subsystem.db: the local database is not ready
subsystem.engine: the orchestration engine is not ready

repair.title: Orchestration engine is not ready
repair.description: Nexus needs an orchestration provider to run tasks. Complete the two steps below, then recheck.
repair.failure: A provider is selected, but its readiness check failed: {{reason}}.

form.title: Configure an orchestration provider
form.candidatesError: Could not read the local agent list. You can still fill in the configuration below.
form.detectionOnly: Detected, not launchable from here yet

stepRecheck.title: Recheck
stepRecheck.body: After configuring, click the button below to recheck the engine status.

helper.soft: Fix the issue and tap Continue again.
helper.migrationDb: If this persists, use Reset below to clear local database state. Your workspace files are not deleted.

toast.workspaceBootstrapFailedDescription: {{message}} Retry Continue, or use Reset local database below if the problem persists.
